title: A call is correlation, not ownership
summary: Call control, inbound audio, outbound audio, RTP receiver and RTP sender are independent objects. Correlation groups them without creating shared ownership, lifecycle, execution context, failure state or causation.
invariants: SipCall is a composition/correlation boundary, not an all-owning session object.
SipCallControl, SipInboundAudio, SipOutboundAudio, RtpReceiver and RtpSender retain independent lifecycle.
Stopping inbound media must not stop outbound media or signalling.
A failed STT consumer, TTS producer, logger or instrumentation observer must not terminate the SIP dialog.
Do not introduce startEverything/stopEverything as the primary lifecycle API.
Correlation is not ownership and correlation is not causation.
procedure: For each new participant, define identity, lifecycle owner, failure domain and explicit correlation fields.
Add lifecycle-isolation regression coverage whenever a participant is added.
